About to pull the plug on my Instantly campaign but thought I would bounce my copy off you guys before I did.
Hi Everyone, 

I run a small credit card processing company. I read a lot on here and settled on Instantly to launch my email campaign. Went for about 2 months. Sent out about 9600 emails and got absolutely nothing back. Did 6 campaigns with 6 different copies and only got OOO and requests to be removed. I warmed up all the inboxes properly. My email boxes remained at 100% health the entire time. Read a lot of what other people were having issues with and tried to fine tune it. My only thought was it has to be my copy and my offer. So I am posting my initial emails to get your feedback.  My subscription expires in 3 days and I have it set to NOT auto renew.  Thinking about using the funds for something else as this does not seem to be working for my business type. 

**Campaign 1 targeting Manufacturing Subject: Level 3 rates - {{companyName}}**

Hi {{firstName}}, does {{companyName}} manually capture Level 3 line-item data on B2B card orders, or is your system setting up corporate discount rates automatically?

Auto-qualifying Level 3 data on commercial orders typically saves mid-market manufacturers $30,000 to $50,000 a year. Send over a recent statement—if we can't show you clear savings, I'll send you $100.

Open to taking a quick 60-second look at the math?

Best,

Scott
